title: QR loyalty redemption
brief: Print QR codes on FreshSip multipacks; scanning a code adds 50 loyalty points to the signed-in customer's account.
clarifications: Can one code be redeemed by more than one account?
What does the customer see for invalid, expired or already-used codes?
Is there a daily per-account limit on scans?

requirements.title: Single-use codes
criteria: A code credits points at most once across all accounts.
Duplicate scans (double-tap or retry) are idempotent and credit once.

requirements.title: Invalid codes
criteria: Malformed, unknown, expired and revoked codes are rejected with distinct, non-enumerable messages.
Failed attempts are rate-limited per account.

test_plan: Concurrent redemption of the same code by two accounts credits exactly once
Replay of the same request with the same idempotency key
Expired code at a timezone boundary
implementation_note: Template and preview only. These are not implemented end to end in this prototype.
